description: Sync forms and their completed and partial responses from the Typeform workspaces you choose. Each response links to its form.
opening: Sync forms and responses from the Typeform workspaces you select, including forms created later. Each form is one document with its numbered questions and answer options. Each completed or partial response is one document of question and answer pairs, linked to its form. Text in uploaded files can be searchable with the response.

Typeform workspace membership is not imported, so every synced form and response is visible to everyone who can query the collection unless you set an access rule. That includes respondent emails and other answers. Forms and responses deleted in Typeform stay in HydraDB.

connect.auth: Typeform uses a personal access token. Accounts hosted in the EU also set a region.

credentials.name: token
credentials.text: A Typeform personal access token with the scopes below.

credentials.name: region
credentials.text: The Typeform data center: `us`, the default, `eu` for EU accounts, or `eu_new` for EU accounts created from August 2025. An EU account without it is read from the US data center.

permissions.name: forms:read
permissions.text: to list the forms in each selected workspace and read their questions.

permissions.name: responses:read
permissions.text: to read completed and partial responses and their answers.

permissions.name: workspaces:read
permissions.text: to list workspaces and the forms in each.

steps.title: Create a personal access token
steps.text: In Typeform, create a personal access token with `forms:read`, `responses:read` and `workspaces:read`.

steps.title: Create the connector
steps.text: Paste the token as `token`. If the Typeform account is hosted in the EU, set `region` to `eu`, or to `eu_new` for an account created from August 2025.

steps.title: Select workspaces
steps.text: HydraDB lists the workspaces the token can see. Select the ones to sync. Every form in a selected workspace syncs, including forms created later. Each workspace syncs separately.

connect.account: One connector reads the workspaces one Typeform token can see, in one region.

sync.first_sync: Reaches back the window set by `lookback_days`, 30 days by default.
sync.changes: Each sync reads forms updated since the last sync, completed responses by when they were submitted, and partial responses by their `staged_at` time. Response reads overlap the previous sync by 30 minutes. A form not updated in the window is read again only when it gets new responses.
sync.edits: An updated form replaces its document. A partial response and its completed version share one document, so they are not duplicated. Later changes to a response outside its time window are not guaranteed to come across.
sync.deletes: Deleted forms and responses are not removed. A form or response deleted in Typeform stays searchable in HydraDB. A form that is deleted, or a workspace the token can no longer see, is skipped, and its earlier documents stay.

shared_attributes.name: additional_metadata.typeform_id
shared_attributes.text: The form id on a form, and the response id on a response. Targets one item. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: connector_id
shared_attributes.text: Limits a query to this connector's items. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: stream_type
shared_attributes.text: The record type, `forms`, `responses` or `partial_responses`, shown when you inspect the item. To limit a query to completed or partial responses, use `additional_metadata.typeform_response_type`.

documents.name: Forms
documents.one_document: One form, with its current questions.
documents.title: The form title.
documents.text: The form's questions in order, numbered, with sub-questions indented and numbered 2.1 and so on. A question with choices is followed by an `Options` line. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: When the form was last updated, or created if there is no update time.
documents.link_back: The public form, else its address in Typeform's API.

attributes.name: Questions and options
attributes.text: Every question of the form and the answer options it offers.

attributes.name: last_updated_at, created_at
attributes.text: When the form was last updated and created. The update time, else the creation time, sets the result date. Not searchable.

attributes.name: Other form fields
attributes.text: Every other field of the form. Kept for inspection only.

documents.name: Responses
documents.title: `Response to <form title>` or `Partial response to <form title>`. Without a form title, `Typeform response <id>` or `Typeform partial response <id>`.
documents.text: The title, then a `Q:` line with the question and an `A:` line with the answer for each answer, in the form's question order. Choices show as their labels, yes or no questions as yes or no, file uploads as the file name, and payments as name and amount. Then `Hidden fields`, `Score`, `Browser`, `Platform` and `Came from` lines.
documents.date: When the response was submitted, else its `staged_at` time, else its `landed_at` time.
documents.files: Files uploaded in answers. Supported files are downloaded with your token and their text is searchable with the response. If a file cannot be downloaded or read, only its name is searchable.

attributes.name: Answers
attributes.text: Each answer, labelled by its question, so a search can match the question and the answer together.

attributes.name: File uploads
attributes.text: Each uploaded file's name, in its answer, and the file's text when it can be read.

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.text: Hidden fields passed to the form, written as the `Hidden fields` line.

attributes.name: calculated_score
attributes.text: The response's score, written as the `Score` line only for forms that define a score.

attributes.name: referer
attributes.text: The page the respondent came from, written as the `Came from` line with only its host and path. The full address is kept for inspection.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.typeform_browser
attributes.text: The respondent's browser family, written as the `Browser` line. Limits a query to responses from one browser family.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.typeform_platform
attributes.text: The respondent's device class, written as the `Platform` line. Limits a query to responses from one device class.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.typeform_response_type
attributes.text: `completed` or `partial`. Includes or leaves out responses that were never submitted. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.typeform_form_id
attributes.text: The form id. Limits a query to the responses of one form. Not searchable.

attributes.name: form_id
attributes.text: The form the response belongs to. Links the response to its form. Not searchable.

attributes.name: submitted_at, staged_at, landed_at
attributes.text: Response times. The first one present, in this order, sets the result date. Not searchable.

attributes.name: Other response fields
attributes.text: Every other field of the response. Kept for inspection only.

example_searches: What questions does the Customer Onboarding form ask, and what options does question 3 offer?
What did respondents answer to "What is your biggest challenge?" on the Feedback form?
What does the resume PDF uploaded in the job application response say?

graph.people: No people are attached to items. A respondent's name or email in an answer is part of the text only.
graph.from_text: Form questions and options, response answers, and the text of uploaded files.

not_synced: Respondents' network ids and user agents.
Deletions: forms and responses deleted in Typeform stay in HydraDB.
